title: 最大子数组和
statement: 给定整数数组 nums，找出和最大的连续非空子数组，返回这个最大和。

en.title: Maximum Subarray
en.statement: Given an integer array nums, find the contiguous non-empty subarray with the largest sum and return that sum.

complexity.space: O(1) extra space (Kadane); divide and conquer uses an O(log n) recursion stack
complexity.officialRequirement: No official complexity requirement; the follow-up suggests also trying a divide-and-conquer solution beyond the O(n) one (no complexity specified).
complexity.notes: n is the array length. Kadane: the best sum ending at i = max(nums[i], result at the previous position + nums[i]). Divide and conquer is O(n log n) (or O(n) when merging segment info). For an all-negative array the answer is the largest single element. The maximum sum does not exceed 10^9, within 32-bit integer range. The largest local test has 60000 elements (official limit 100000, reduced to keep the problem bank small).

en.acmIoSpec: stdin: first line n; second line n integers. stdout: one integer, the maximum subarray sum.

complexity.space: O(1) 额外空间（Kadane）；分治为 O(log n) 递归栈
complexity.officialRequirement: 官方未强制复杂度要求；follow-up 建议在 O(n) 解法之外再尝试分治解法（未规定复杂度）。
complexity.notes: n 为数组长度。Kadane：以 i 结尾的最大和 = max(nums[i], 前一位置结果 + nums[i])。分治 O(n log n)（或合并区间信息的 O(n)）。全负数组时答案为最大的单个元素。最大和不超过 10^9，在 32 位整数范围内。本地最大测试为 60000 个元素（官方上限 100000，为控制题库体积而缩小）。

cpp.acmIoSpec: stdin：第一行 n；第二行 n 个整数。stdout：一个整数，最大子数组和。
